modules.name: tb_keyboard_crossing

reset.name: rstn
reset.values: all pipeline valid and output data/tag registers clear; external synchronous release

behavior: 2064 directed/random reference vectors, including32key histories, unsigned timestamp wrap, both motion polarities, exact endpoint threshold, zero/stale intervals, reversals and no motion.
Assert both timestamps, estimation flags and valid-history interval against Python integer model; bound completion below80core clocks.
constraints: Simulation only.50MHz clock with accelerated10-cycle millisecond and100ms watchdog.
corner_cases: Both ADC directions; incomplete config; threshold chatter; held key during commit; same-sample fast crossing; long holds; watchdog.
verification_cases: test_crossing_vectors.py generates deterministic fixture; xsim executes every vector.
